dedupe_keys.name: ines passive house energyplus calibration and hybrid ventilation models

description: This deposit provides two EnergyPlus input files for a full-scale passive test house at the French National Institute for Solar Energy near Chambéry. University of Stuttgart, INES/CEA and Brazilian university researchers supply a calibration model and an annual-analysis model to assess natural and hybrid ventilation. Geometry was prepared through SketchUp and OpenStudio, with EnergyPlus 9.1 used for the reported simulations. The article documents six time steps per hour, Airflow Network openings and Energy Management System controls. Its calibration covers an August week, while the annual model runs January–December; a calendar year was not established. Mendeley version 2 publishes both IDF files free under CC BY 4.0. The originally unoccupied house uses an assumed family occupancy schedule, which is a limitation when representing real residents. Modellers could adapt the files for ventilation or thermal-demand comparisons. model-energyplus is the required simulation engine. Neither file was downloaded or run, and compatibility with later software versions remains unchecked.
